description:
Follow Marvel stories across series and pick up at your next unread comic. Recap Page gives you reading lists for events, eras and characters, with progress, notes and ratings saved on your device.

Mark comics read as you go, or mark a whole list read at once. Save everything to a backup file, or turn on automatic backup to your own OneDrive. OneDrive is optional and off until you choose it. Microsoft can read your backups, your account protects them, and the developer never receives them.

When a comic has a Marvel Comics link, Read opens that link. Until reading in Marvel Unlimited ends on December 7, 2026, some comics can also be opened there. Starting December 7, Read opens the general Marvel Comics website for a comic without a Marvel Comics link. Comics are not included. Marvel decides what is available to read and whether an account or payment is needed.

You do not need a Recap Page account. There are no ads or tracking. Covers and comic details come from Marvel and a comics information website.

Reading lists credit Comic Book Herald and Comic Book Reading Orders where their guides supply the comics and order. Some Marvel Comics links come from Comic Book Reading Orders.

This is an unofficial fan companion, not affiliated with or endorsed by Marvel Entertainment or Disney. Marvel names and marks belong to their owners.
notesForCertification:
Prepared for Recap Page 4.7.0, package version 4.7.0.0.

Launching starts a hidden local server at 127.0.0.1:8787 and opens the default browser or its installed Recap Page app window. It accepts no remote connections, and no console stays open. No account is needed to track reading.

1. Launch from Start. In Edge or Chrome, install Recap Page as an app if offered. It can then open in its own window from Start.
2. On Home, open Modern Timeline and find House of M. Preview it, add it to Library, mark a comic read and add a note.
3. Close and relaunch in the same browser profile. Confirm the progress and note remain.
4. In Backup & settings, export a complete backup. Restoring requires confirmation and replaces saved data; use test data.
5. OneDrive is optional. Use a personal test account you control, connect under Backup & settings, review any backups, turn on automatic backup, and make a reading change. Check the backup status. Use test data to test restore.
6. Delete this device's cloud backups removes recognized files for this installation. Disconnect also offers deletion. OneDrive can retain deleted files in its recycle bin. Local erase and uninstall do not delete cloud copies.

For comics with a Marvel Comics link, Read opens that link outside Recap Page. Until reading in Marvel Unlimited ends December 7, 2026, it may also be offered. Starting December 7, Read opens the general Marvel Comics website for comics without a Marvel Comics link. Comics and credentials are not provided.

The app contacts external services for comic details, cover images and reading. Marvel Fandom is contacted only when chosen. Microsoft sign-in and OneDrive are used only when chosen. Backups are compressed but not encrypted by the app, can be read by Microsoft and never go to the developer.

The app has no updater, release check, download link or in-app purchases. It updates only through Microsoft Store. Its only restricted capability is runFullTrust.
